---
title: "Progression-free survival — endpoint preparation"
format: html
execute:
  freeze: false
---

PFS is the first documented progression or death from randomization. Follow-up
uses the 2026-09-05 data lock without a 182-day cap, as for BSC. Same-day progression and
death count as one composite event. No cause-specific PFS model is fitted. Missing baseline covariates are imputed in the next stage.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-pfs
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
source(here::here("R", "analysis-config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "data-helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "event-survival-helpers.R"))

config <- read_analysis_config()
artifact_dir <- here::here("artifacts", "secondary", "pfs")
result_dir <- here::here("results", "secondary", "pfs")

dir.create(artifact_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- arrow::read_parquet(here::here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"))
endpoint <- derive_pfs_endpoint(cohort, config$analysis$data_lock)

prepared <- endpoint |>
  filter(pfs_in_analysis) |>
  select(id, tx, pfs_time_days, event_pfs, diagnosis, ecog_fstcnt, stage_binary,
         lung, age, gender, albumin, bilirubin, c_reactive_protein, lactate_dehydrogenase)

stopifnot(nrow(prepared) > 0L, sum(prepared$event_pfs) > 0L, !anyNA(prepared$diagnosis))
endpoint_audit <- endpoint |> count(tx, pfs_exclusion_reason, name = "participants")

event_counts <- endpoint |>
  filter(pfs_in_analysis) |>
  summarise(participants = n(), progression_first = sum(event_progression),
            death_before_progression = sum(event_death_before_progression),
            pfs_events = sum(event_pfs), censored = sum(event_pfs == 0), .by = tx)

arrow::write_parquet(endpoint, file.path(result_dir, "endpoint.parquet"))
arrow::write_parquet(prepared, file.path(artifact_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
arrow::write_parquet(endpoint_audit, file.path(result_dir, "endpoint-audit.parquet"))
arrow::write_parquet(event_counts, file.path(result_dir, "event-counts.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pfs-exclusions
#| tbl-cap: "PFS analysis population and exclusions"
knitr::kable(endpoint_audit)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pfs-event-counts
#| tbl-cap: "First progression or death events by randomized group"
knitr::kable(event_counts)
```
